question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fast
solution:
The correct answer is: **Quick**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fast"** means moving or capable of moving at high speed or happening in a short time. (तेज़)
 
 
• **Example:** He ran so fast that he broke the school record.
 
 
 
• **"Quick"** refers to something done with speed or taking a short amount of time. (शीघ्र)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a quick response to the question.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'fast'** is **'quick'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Quick**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Barely **(मुश्किल से): Only just; almost not.
 
 
• **Example:** He could barely hear the speaker in the noisy room.
 
 
 
• **Tardy **(देरी से): Delaying or delayed beyond the right or expected time.
 
 
• **Example:** The student was marked tardy for arriving late to class.
 
 
 
• **Languid **(सुस्त): Displaying or having a disinclination for physical exertion or effort; slow and relaxed.
 
 
• **Example:** She moved with a languid grace.
